env.#1: IndexNow key (8-128 chars of [A-Za-z0-9-]). Generate one: bin/console indexnow:key:generate --write-env
env.#2: Absolute site URL, used by console commands and Messenger workers (no request context there), e.g. https://www.example.com

post-install-output: * Generate a key and write it to <comment>.env.local</comment>:
* Set <comment>INDEXNOW_BASE_URL</comment> to your public site URL (in .env.local / the server environment).
